newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rates fall at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rates fall at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 728-day development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.24 percentage points to 1.3 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 98.01697 pesos.
Demand for the two-year Bondes was 2.251 billion pesos, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
The rate on the 364-day Bondes fell 0.41 percentage points to 1.2 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate, at an assigned price of 98.95203 pesos.
There were 500 million 364-day pesos assigned compared to 2.685 billion pesos worth demanded.
